scope: Functional modeled mixture and propeller controls on 17 appropriate aircraft; 53-aircraft control coverage verified.
authoring: Existing deterministic generators and materials retained. Mixture/propeller interaction metadata, rest-relative lever motion and missing supported control geometry exported in glTF extras. No new bitmap textures or external model inputs.
changes: Per-engine and common retained mixture and propeller selections. Common throttle changes preserve mixture, propeller and engine cutoff overrides.
Density-aware piston mixture affects combustion, power, thrust, torque and propwash. Cutoff removes powered thrust immediately; fuel restoration permits assisted restart without clearing failures.
Constant-speed governor selection affects RPM, propeller rotation, shaft power and static/cruise thrust. Low power can fall below selected RPM at the fine-pitch stop.

Existing colored cockpit levers are draggable. Add the R44 mixture and Dash 8 propeller controls. Correct Baron and King Air lever-name collisions and keep Baron grips above the pedestal throughout travel.
Only capability-enabled aircraft expose these controls. Fixed-pitch and automatically managed engines retain their appropriate control layouts.

validation.kernel: 359 tests passed after final propwash change; TypeScript check passed. Covers altitude leaning, cutoff/restart/failure, per-engine RPM/power, helicopter shaft cutoff, ignored unsupported controls, deterministic replay and finite input validation.
validation.earth: All 10 aircraft integration tests passed, including physical mixture cutoff and propeller settings retained across keyboard throttle changes.
validation.entities: 825 other entity tests passed; both 53-aircraft source/runtime interaction tests passed after final Baron fix, including mixture/propeller minimum and maximum settings.
validation.integrity: All 53 source/runtime aircraft assets verified. Gallery hashes match imported assets: 53 aircraft, 65 views.
validation.catalog: 198 logical entity source bundles verified; generated schema docs current (43 files).
validation.sources: 1487 logical source bundles and 1064 structure recipe indexes verified; no bulk review captures tracked.
validation.headless: CLI scene validation and 240-tick simulation passed all four independent cutoff/governor assertions.
validation.smokePacked: Passed: 17 release tarballs installed; seven templates scaffolded, checked, tested and built. The final propwash normalization was subsequently covered by the full kernel suite and Earth aircraft integration tests.
validation.formatting: Biome checks passed for changed schema, kernel, client, generator and test modules.
validation.repositoryGate: pnpm verify blocked because no shared asset bundle is installed. pnpm docs:site:check and pnpm test:golden blocked during prerequisite build by four missing Putra Mosque LOD GLBs. Full CI is not claimed green.

liveChecks: At equal 80% throttle, dragging Baron engine 1 propeller to minimum settled at 60% RPM and 107 kW while engine 2 remained at 94% RPM and 179 kW.
Dragging Baron engine 1 mixture to cutoff reduced that engine to zero RPM and shaft power while engine 2 stayed powered.
Dragging the same mixture lever back to full rich restarted engine 1; the lever remained reachable at cutoff.

limitations: Reduced deterministic simulation curves and estimated 60%-100% governor ranges, not certified performance tables or operating procedures.
No fuel consumption, EGT/CHT, detonation, starter/ignition sequence, feathering, reverse thrust or blade-element aerodynamics.
GLTFExporter normalized a source normal attribute during the reproducibility rebuild; all 17 resulting files remained byte-identical.
Supplemental cockpit control placement remains a medium-fi approximation. Bulk render evidence stays local.
